title: 第7章 厉鬼作祟阴司现身第8章 拘神显神通
slug: 别人修仙我闲逛游历三界终长生
content_zh:
王学海会心一笑，对着家仆招手示意。
不一会儿，饭菜便端了上来。
四凉四热一汤，有鱼有肉，还有一壶酒。
虽然不如现代大酒楼里的饭菜，但也看的纪风直咽口水。
他这两天就没吃过一顿正经饭。
“诸位大师，请动筷！”
王学海说完，周围人便不再客气，纷纷动筷。
纪风也不慢，给知白碗里夹了块红烧肉，又给自己夹了一块。
“公子，好吃！”
片刻，八仙桌上只剩残羹剩饭。
纪风也打起了饱嗝。
一顿饭吃完，王学海站起身来，带着众人往后院走去。
穿过两道月亮门，到了一处独立的院子。
院子不大，正房三间，东西厢房各两间。
此时几间房屋门窗紧闭，贴着黄符，门框之上还挂着一面八卦镜。
王学海站在院门口，似乎不愿往里迈步。
看向众人：“就是这儿了，前些日子，我家一个老嬷住在这儿，半夜突然尖叫，等护卫赶到，她已经......已经死了。”
“怎么死的？”
“面色惨白如纸，双目圆睁，瞳孔散大，嘴微张。”
想起那场景，王学海脸色发白：“县衙的人也来了，说是被鬼吓死的，便草草了案。”

“此后每每有人夜晚路过此院，都能听到里边有女子在哭。”
王学海往后退了两步：
“诸位大师，今晚就在这儿歇息，不管是谁，只要能除了那脏东西，百两纹银和那套雅居，王某决不食言。”
“王员外，你瞧好吧，看我不一刀劈了那玩意。”
李虎肩扛大刀，一脚踹开小院大门。
顿时，一股阴风吹来，烈日高悬，却让众人打了个冷颤。
见状，王学海再次道谢，随后扭头就走，头也不回。
“咳咳！”
李虎似乎意识到事情没那么简单，但还是硬着胆子走了进去。
其余人在院外互相看了看。
话说吃人嘴短拿人手短，此时再想走，怕是不那么简单。
“阿弥陀佛。”
智远和尚念了声佛号，便走了进去。
随后是道士。
content_en:
Wang Xuehai smiled knowingly and waved to the servant.
After a while, the food was served.
Four cold, four hot, one soup, fish, meat, and a pot of wine.
Although it was not as good as the food in a modern restaurant, Ji Feng still swallowed hard when he saw it.
He hasn't had a proper meal in the past two days.
"Masters, please use your chopsticks!"
After Wang Xuehai finished speaking, the people around him stopped being polite and moved their chopsticks one after another.
Ji Feng was not slow and put a piece of braised pork into Zhibai's bowl and another piece for himself.
"Son, it's delicious!"
For a moment, there were only leftovers on the Eight Immortals' table.
Ji Feng also burped.
After finishing the meal, Wang Xuehai stood up and led everyone to the backyard.
Passing through two moon gates, we arrived at an independent courtyard.
The yard is not big, with three main rooms and two east and west wing rooms.
At this time, the doors and windows of several houses were closed, yellow symbols were posted, and a Bagua mirror hung on the door frame.
Wang Xuehai stood at the entrance of the courtyard, seemingly unwilling to step inside.
Looking at everyone: "This is it. A few days ago, an old lady of mine lived here. She suddenly screamed in the middle of the night. When the guards arrived, she was already... dead."
"How did you die?"
"The face was as pale as paper, the eyes were wide open, the pupils were dilated, and the mouth was slightly open."
Thinking of that scene, Wang Xuehai's face turned pale: "People from the county government also came, saying that he was scared to death by ghosts, so they settled the case hastily."
"Since then, every time someone passes by this courtyard at night, they can hear a woman crying inside."
Wang Xuehai took two steps back:
"Masters, please rest here tonight. No matter who it is, as long as they can get rid of that dirty thing, a hundred taels of silver, and that elegant residence, Wang will never break his promise."
"Wang Yuanwai, just wait and see if I don't chop that thing with my sword."
Li Hu carried a big knife on his shoulder and kicked open the door of the small courtyard.
Suddenly, a dark wind blew, and the scorching sun hung high, but it made everyone shiver.
Seeing this, Wang Xuehai thanked him again, then turned around and left without looking back.
"Ahem!"
Li Hu seemed to realize that things were not that simple, but he still bravely walked in.
The rest of the people looked at each other outside the hospital.
It is said that eating people is short of mouth and short of hands. If you want to leave at this time, I am afraid it will not be that simple.
"Amitabha."
Monk Zhiyuan recited the Buddha's name and walked in.
Then came the Taoist priests.
